name: ctm360-hackerview
label: CTM360 HackerView
description: HackerView is CTM360’s External Attack Surface Management platform, offering automated asset discovery, issue identification, security ratings, and third-party risk management. This collector lets you pull the issues and assets found on attack surface.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.description: Specify the Server URL to which you want to connect and perform automated information.
fields.name: server
fields.tooltip: Specify the Server URL to which you want to connect and perform automated information.

fields.title: API Key
fields.description: Specify the API Key to connect to the endpoint and perform automated operations.
fields.name: api_key
fields.tooltip: Specify the API Key to connect to the endpoint and perform automated operations.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is selected, i.e., set to true.
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is selected, i.e., set to true.

operations.title: Get Issues
operations.description: Retrieves a list of issues found on your attack surface from CTM360 HackerView based on the filter criteria that you have specified.

parameters.title: First Seen
parameters.description: Specify the date and time to include only items that appeared for the first time after the given timestamp.
parameters.name: first_seen
parameters.tooltip: Specify the date and time to include only items that appeared for the first time after the given timestamp. The date must be in the format DD-MM-YYYY hh:mm, for example: "01-01-2025 00:00".

operations.title: Get Domains
operations.description: Retrieves a list of your genuine domains from CTM360 HackerView.

operations.title: Get Hosts
operations.description: Retrieves a list of your genuine hostnames from CTM360 HackerView.

operations.title: Get IP Addresses
operations.description: Retrieves a list of your associated IP addresses from CTM360 HackerView.

operations.title: Get Resolved Issues
operations.description: Retrieves a list of resolved issues found on your attack surface from CTM360 HackerView based on the filter criteria that you have specified.

parameters.title: From Date
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the date and time to retrieve results that include only those items that were seen after the specified timestamp.
parameters.name: from_date
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify the date and time to retrieve results that include only those items that were seen after the specified timestamp. The date must be in the format DD-MM-YYYY hh:mm, for example: "01-01-2025 00:00".

parameters.title: To Date
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the date and time to retrieve results that include only those items that were seen before the specified timestamp.
parameters.name: to_date
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify the date and time to retrieve results that include only those items that were seen before the specified timestamp. The date must be in the format DD-MM-YYYY hh:mm, for example: "01-01-2025 00:00".
